description: This PHP source file defines an event subscriber class 'FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber' within the OrangeHRM project. It listens to Symfony kernel controller events and enforces restrictions during functional testing, specifically throwing a ForbiddenException if a certain condition is met regarding the request path and product mode.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that intercepts controller events to restrict access during certain functional testing scenarios in production mode.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events to which this subscriber subscribes, specifically the Kernel's controller event.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event; checks request path and product mode, throws ForbiddenException if conditions are met to restrict access.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event object.
